The four Hash sheets explain how sensitive values are hashed or encrypted now (50-100 users) and how protection grows with more users.
Each table has its own colour in every sheet, so rows of one table are easy to spot.
High = personal data (email, phone, DOB, identity IDs, OTP hash). Medium = internal references / masked numbers. Low = statuses and times.
PK = primary key. FK = link to another table. UNIQUE = no two rows may share the value. CHECK = a rule the database enforces. Trigger = code the database runs automatically.
All links to users use ON DELETE RESTRICT (never CASCADE). Full Aadhaar / PAN numbers are never stored - masked values only. All test data is synthetic.
